name: Watts On Data Reader
description: Once-daily private heating and water collection from Watts On. A persistent Android sidecar preserves the signed-in app session, while the collector requests a configurable two- or three-day overlap (three by default) and stores only available readings. Trailing all-zero provider placeholders are withheld without discarding valid earlier zero-usage intervals.
short_desc: Once-daily Watts heating and water history collector.
author: Asger1002

form_fields.label: Daily snapshot time (24-hour HH:MM)
form_fields.hint: One attempt per local calendar day. A failed attempt is not retried that day; the rolling overlap catches up automatically.

form_fields.label: IANA time zone
form_fields.hint: Controls both the schedule and local-day boundaries.

form_fields.label: Rolling overlap
form_fields.hint: Still uses only one heating GET and one water GET. Overlapping timestamps are updated idempotently.
